decision_reason: Illumina RNA supports the in-frame deletion and Vaxrank selects a target-bearing 25-aa construct.

interpretation: The RNA and nominated edit agree, providing a robust complex-indel reconstruction control across the DNA, RNA, protein, and epitope layers. A separate audit found alternate fragments in both technologies and both samples.
limitation: The rank is specific to the five assessed patient class-I alleles and default filters.
